messages:
maria_support: escalating to CS — Aletheia Labs (trial) seeing intermittent 504s and timeouts from embeddings endpoint. ~25 failures in 30m. Ticket INC-7198.

ashley_cs: thanks. who is the POC and what did they change? impact on trial metrics?

maria_support: POC is sam@aletheia.ai. They started ingest yesterday, using high-concurrency workerpool (concurrency=10) and batch size 256. Logs: `504 Gateway Time-out` and `curl: (28) Operation timed out after 30000ms`.

tom_csm: this is potentially a renewal signal if they can't complete ingest. proposed comms: 1) immediate ack (<20m) with apology, 2) offer 30m troubleshooting within 3 hours, 3) propose temporary throttling and model pin.

ryan_runtime: checking runtime traces. one backend pod is restarting due to GPU OOM when sequence length >1500 and batch >128. quick mitigation: tenant-scoped limit to concurrency=2 and max_batch_size=64 or route to quantized embed variant.

ashley_cs: please apply customer-scoped mitigation canary and share rollback window. i'll send the ack and propose a call.

deploy-bot: deployment started by ryan_runtime: apply-tenant-policy aletheia-throttle -> canary

ryan_runtime: canary shows error rate dropped to ~4% in last 10m. I'll also add a runtime flag to reduce kernel mem allocs for that pod while we investigate.

sam_aletheia: thanks for speedy action. 15:30 UTC call works. we'll bring sample payloads.

tom_csm: i'll join call and draft post-call summary with rollback plan and follow-up SLA actions. flagging account as "watch" until 48h post-fix.

ashley_cs: thanks everyone. next steps: 1) 15:30 UTC call (ashley + tom + ryan) 2) written recap to sam with mitigations and timelines 3) eng-runtime to triage root cause and PR fix.

ryan_runtime: oncall acked. i'll collect core dumps and run repro with sampled payloads. if necessary we'll land a kernel-fix or limit batch scheduler.

maria_support: ticket updated INC-7198 with canary results and mitigation steps.

ashley_cs: i've sent ack to sam and added renewal-risk indicator. will check back 48h after resolution. :white_check_mark:

sam_aletheia: appreciate the quick support. see you on the call.
